# WhatEverFi

Open source

Give your bots a job. Check in from any device.

## Give each bot a job

Start with a template. Make it yours.

- **Sales Outbound:** Research prospects and draft follow-ups.
- **Inbox Manager:** Sort email and draft replies.
- **Talent Scout:** Review applications and shortlist candidates.
- **Expense Manager:** Match receipts to payments.
- **Coding Agent:** Make code changes on your computer.
- **Account Manager:** Prepare replies and track renewals.
- **Paid Media:** Review ad spend and report changes.
- **Chief of Staff:** Prepare briefings and coordinate your bots.

## Message them anywhere

Mention a bot in Slack or text it from your phone.

- Slack
- iMessage & SMS (Self-hosted)
- WhatsApp (Self-hosted)
- Telegram (Self-hosted)

## More than chat

- **Works in your apps:** Connect Gmail, GitHub, Notion, and any MCP server.
- **Learns by watching:** Show a task once on its computer. It saves the steps as a skill.
- **Remembers:** Bots keep what they learn and share it with the team.
- **Wakes up on its own:** On a schedule, a webhook, a GitHub event, or a change it watches.
- **Hands off work:** Bots delegate to each other and work together in groups.
- **It calls you:** When something needs you, your bot calls you in the app. Talk it through.

## Self-hosted

Your machine, your models, your control.

- **Your model:** Choose a different model for each bot.
- **Work on a schedule:** Keeps working while your computer is off.
- **You set the limits:** Decide which actions need your approval.

Works with: Claude, ChatGPT, OpenRouter, Grok, Ollama, LM Studio.

## Open source

Apache-2.0. Run it, change it, make it yours.

[Cloud](https://app.whateverfi.com): Beta.

## FAQ

### Can I use my Claude Pro/Max or ChatGPT Plus/Pro subscription?

Use ChatGPT sign-in with an eligible plan, or connect an API key. For Claude, use an Anthropic API key; Pro and Max subscriptions do not include API credit. See Model subscriptions in the docs for provider restrictions.

### Can I run a local model?

Yes. Point a bot at a local OpenAI-compatible server such as Ollama or LM Studio. Each bot can use a different model.

### What does the hosted plan include?

A cloud computer and a monthly allowance of computer hours that grows with your plan, with up to 5 computers running at once. There are no overage charges.
